## Marvell Technology Falls ~13.5% After Pushing Out Hyperscaler AI Custom-Silicon Revenue Timeline

MRVL's -13.5% on a timeline push is a key calibration for the AI ASIC cycle: custom-silicon programs are advancing, but on elongated schedules, creating a gap between bull-case earnings and current reality. Positions in MRVL and peers (AVGO, and any name with hyperscaler custom-silicon exposure) should be stress-tested against delayed ramp scenarios, and the reaction size confirms the market is pricing in little tolerance for slippage.

- MRVL declined approximately 13.5% after communicating a delay in the expected timing of its hyperscaler AI custom-silicon revenue payoff.
- The selloff indicates investors had been pricing an earlier ramp; the timeline extension creates a near-term earnings gap versus prior expectations.
- Coverage is single-outlet; no specific new timeline, program details, or hyperscaler counterparty names are confirmed in the headline.
- The reaction illustrates how sensitively AI infrastructure names are priced to ramp cadence — any slip triggers outsized multiple compression.
